in_marathi.name: Vanshika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vanshika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vanshika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vansh' which means 'descent' or 'lineage', and 'Shri' which means 'Goddess'. The name Vanshika signifies the descent of the Goddess of Prosperity. It is believed that the name bestows prosperity, happiness, and good fortune upon the child.
